calls.video_title: Why Is Nebius Stock Falling, and is it a Buying Opportunity? | NBIS Stock Analysis
calls.thesis: HOLD reiterated — he states he rated NBIS a buying opportunity earlier this year, downgraded it to HOLD after the run-up, and keeps it at HOLD after refreshing his DCF: $225 FV vs $186 is ~21% upside, but that sits inside the 10-20% margin of safety he demands for one of the riskiest stocks in the market, so it is not confidently undervalued and not an attractive buying opportunity. Stock down 10.4% today on soaring neocloud funding costs. First tracked Parkevtate NBIS call in calls.json — no flip vs tracked calls.
calls.base_case: Revenue expected to soar from $550M to $3.34B in 2026 and +268% in 2027 on waiting demand; supply/demand favours capacity owners at least through next year; balance sheet much better than CoreWeave's (~$8B cash vs far lower debt than CRWV's ~$50B).
calls.bull_case: Spot-market capacity strategy lets Nebius capture prevailing high prices while demand exceeds supply; +121% YTD even after the recent pullback.
calls.bear_case: Reaching 5GW by 2030 needs ~$250B of capital as interest costs soar and lenders may restrict debt (or force equity raises); estimated FCF -$17.5B (2026), -$23B (2027), -$25B (2028); spot exposure cuts both ways if pricing reverses; long-term supply/demand after the industry-wide build-out is the open question.

No buy-now price call in this video, and in his same-day portfolio update he said Nebius is in his buy zone but he is waiting, comfortable with his existing position — so the conditional stance stands.
calls.base_case: Management guides ARR to $7–9B; capex guided $20–25B to fund the buildout; 2027 capacity could be sold today but is partly held back because auction prices cleared 15% above the highest price ever charged for Blackwell chips.
calls.bull_case: Token Factory managed-inference platform (Tavily, Agon AI, Clarifai/Clarify and new ~$150M Infrise acquisitions) raises GPU utilisation and margins toward an AWS/GCP-like enterprise cloud; CRO path cited toward $100B revenue.
calls.bear_case: Very high premium, capital-intensive execution, data-centre permits/delays/lawsuits; large Microsoft/Meta contracts are not high-margin; ARR annualising one month can mislead.
